req.title: Reject non-positive redirect count
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the redirect count is zero or negative.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/<n> must return HTTP 400 when n <= 0. The violation was test[4] (test_redirect_large_negative_returns_400) which had kind=negative but heuristic=EP. A negative test kind must use NEG heuristic (or BVA for boundary-negative). Fixing: change heuristic from EP to NEG for that test. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_redirect_positive_count_returns_redirect
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
redirect count n=1 is a valid positive integer
expected: Response status code is 302 (a redirect, not 400)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: positive path — n=1 satisfies n>0, so no 400 is returned
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_positive_count_returns_redirect():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/get' in location

test_redirect_positive_count_returns_redirect()

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_returns_400
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
redirect count n=0 is exactly at the boundary (not positive)
expected: Status code is NOT 200, NOT 302, NOT 500
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: boundary — n=0 fails n>0 guard, must yield HTTP 400
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_zero_returns_400():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 400
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 500

test_redirect_zero_returns_400()

tests.name: test_redirect_two_returns_redirect_not_400
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
redirect count n=2 is a valid positive integer greater than 1
expected: Location header is present and non-empty
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: DT — n=2 satisfies n>0 AND n!=1, exercises the relative redirect branch; must not return 400
tests.executable:

client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_two_returns_redirect_not_400():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 400
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location != ''
